messages.subject: which interpolation method was used in function "stat_contour" in ggplot2?
parts:
Hello everyones,

I have a question about 'stat_contour' in "ggplot2".
I am using 'ggmap' and 'ggplot2' packages to visualize the spatial distribution of heavy metal in soil on map. I got the heat-map base on the data of heavy metal concentration (at 20 soil sample sites) like the following map by using "stat_contour". 
https://www.flickr.com/photos/124998573@N08/21139201781/in/dateposted-public/

However, I do not know which interpolation method was applied to calculate the contour lines in "stat_contour"  to make this map. Can you help me to answer this question?

Thanks and Best Regards,﻿
